name: pipes.sh
summary: Animated pipes screensaver as a single bash script. Pipe colors are ANSI color indices, so they follow the terminal palette. Windows: use pipes-rs.

windows.notes: Bash script that needs a POSIX bash, tput and a terminfo database; no winget or scoop package. Not seen working under Git Bash, so use pipes-rs on Windows.

install.notes: Fedora: no dnf package found on Repology. The script is one file: download pipes.sh, chmod +x, put it on PATH.

theme.notes: -c INDEX per pipe color (repeatable); the hex comes from the terminal palette.

config.notes: Flags only: pipe count, type, framerate, straightness, reset.
